noun_definition: android refers to the mobile operating system used by users who experience app crashes when interacting with a specific link in the messaging application.
Review duplicate refers to a specific action in the app where a user accesses a modified chat link that includes the "/duplicates/review" path, intended to manage duplicate reports.
App refers to the mobile application that crashes when the user taps "Keep all" after opening a modified chat link on an Android device.
Crash refers to the unexpected termination of the app when the user taps "Keep all" after opening a modified chat link.
Tap refers to the action of pressing on a link within the mobile application to initiate a response or navigate to a different screen.

Keep all refers to a button or action in the mobile application that, when tapped, is intended to allow the user to retain all items or messages in a specific context, but is currently causing the app to crash.

Modified chat link refers to a specific URL that directs a mobile user to a direct message containing a report, with the addition of "/duplicates/review" at the end to facilitate reviewing duplicate reports.
